subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona TTS SecretRefs become active under today's fail-closed startup behavior, or must optional-TTS missing-secret degradation be decided first?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but activating previously ignored targets changes upgrade behavior for stale or missing persona credentials and can turn a localized TTS failure into startup failure.

options.title: Accept current fail-closed policy
options.body: Land this narrow fix after exact-head live proof and explicitly accept that an unresolved configured persona TTS SecretRef can block startup, while handling optional degradation separately.

options.title: Sequence after optional degradation
options.body: Pause this PR until the policy and implementation tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 are resolved, then prove both present-key and missing-key behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept current fail-closed policy
recommendation.body: Land this narrow fix after exact-head live proof and explicitly accept that an unresolved configured persona TTS SecretRef can block startup, while handling optional degradation separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets repository-wide credential activation and startup-failure policy rather than a local TTS implementation detail.
